about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Hunter Layered Armor: Fluffy Ears

Show off your beastly cuteness with this fluffy ear layered armor!

*You can apply Layered Armor from the Hunter Appearance option in the Appearance menu in your tent.
*This item can be equipped on your hunter's head.
*This item changes the appearance of your hunter. It does not affect stats or abilities.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
